resources.string: Place traps to reveal players' roles.
Place traps around the map.\%nl\%Players held inside are revealed next meeting.

The Revealer is a Crewmate role that can place traps around the map. \%nl\%When players stay in a trap for a certain amount of time, \%nl\%their roles are revealed to the Revealer at the next meeting.
Place a trap at your current location. Players who stay in the trap for the required duration will have their roles revealed to you.
No players were caught in your traps.
Not enough players were caught in your traps.
Trap vents around the map.\%nl\%Players using trapped vents are immobilized.
The Trapper is a Crewmate role that can place traps on vents. When players use a trapped vent, they are immobilized for a duration and the Trapper is notified.
Place a trap on a vent. Players who use this vent will be caught and immobilized.
You were caught in a trap in <room>!
Stack your votes and unleash them all at once!
Save votes in your vote bank.\%nl\%Spend them later to swing meetings.
You can Abstain form voting at a meeting, by doing so you are saving votes that you can then spend all at once, For example 10 votes at one meeting.
You save your votes for later meetings.
You have {0} bank votes (+{1} from Monarch)!
Vanish to hide yourself.\%nl\%Reappear early by pressing Unvanish.
You are crewmate Swooper. You can Vanish and observe neutrals/impostors.
Turn invisible for a short time. You can reappear early by pressing Unvanish.
You cannot see your task list, task markers,\%nl\%or task locations on the map.
You cannot see your task list, task markers, or task locations on the map. Tasks still spawn normally and count toward the task bar.
You are a child! Grow up to lose your protection.
You are a Child (Age: <age>/<adultAge>).\%nl\%While underage, you cannot be killed.\%nl\%You grow older every few seconds.\%nl\%Once you reach adulthood, you lose your protection.
When you are a child, you are protected from being killed. Once you reach adulthood, you lose your protection.
When you kill someone, their body rots away.
Venomous is a modifier for Neutral Killing roles. When you kill a player, their body will rot away, preventing it from being reported.
Defend <client> through meetings.\%nl\%You lose if they are voted out.
The <color=#EDB38C>Lawyer</color> is a Neutral Benign role that wins by keeping their assigned client from being voted out. If their client gets voted out, the Lawyer loses.
During meetings, click the objection button on your client\'s vote area to object to all votes, clearing them and forcing players to vote again.
After each kill, your kill cooldown is set to\%nl\%a random value between the configured minimum\%nl\%and maximum.
After each kill, the kill cooldown is randomized between the configured minimum and maximum values. Cannot be assigned to Warlock, Outlaw, or Scavenger.
Lawyer Gets Voted Out With Client
Mark a player before meeting.\%nl\%Steal their role when meeting starts.
You can steal a player's role, but if you try to steal an Impostor/Neutral role you will commit suicide instantly.
Select a player to steal their role at the next meeting.
Shifter Wins With Crew When Alive
Objection! A lawyer has objected to the current votes! All votes have been cleared - please vote again.
You cannot vote for the same person after an objection!
Kill everyone to win alone.\%nl\%Vent kills work, but disable venting.

The Serial Killer is a Neutral Killing role whose only objective is to kill everyone and win alone. The Serial Killer can optionally kill players who are in vents with them, but loses the ability to vent for the rest of the game after doing so.
Swallow players into your stomach.\%nl\%Meetings digest them unless you die first.\%nl\%With voice chat, you can talk to swallowed players privately.

The Pelican is a Neutral Killing role that can swallow players and keep them in their stomach. Swallowed players die in the meeting, and can be set free if the Pelican dies before that. With Mega Chujowe Perfect Comms, the Pelican can privately talk with swallowed players, and nobody outside the stomach can hear them.
Swallow a player and keep them in your stomach. Swallowed players cannot use abilities. With voice chat, you can talk to swallowed players, and nobody outside your stomach can hear that conversation.
You have been swallowed by Pelican!
You have been released from the Pelican!
Challenge players to meeting duels.\%nl\%Win enough duels to claim victory.
You can duel a player and make them play Rock, Paper, Scissors against you during the next meeting. If you win, they die. If you lose, nothing happens. Draws only count if the option is enabled.
Select a player to duel at the next meeting. During the meeting, you play Rock, Paper, or Scissors against them.
Can't Duel The Same Person Twice In A Row
You are being dueled by the Pirate!
You have successfully completed your duels as the {0}! You will now spectate and win with the winning team.
The {0}, {1}, has completed all required duels!
You are jailed! Your duel has been cancelled.
Your duel target is jailed! Duel cancelled.
You can't duel the same person twice in a row.
Give cream cakes and purify everyone with Sanctify.
Give cream cakes to every living player.\%nl\%Then use Sanctify to purify everyone.
Give a cream cake to every living non-Pope. When everyone is marked, use Sanctify to purify everyone. Pope wins if the Sanctification countdown finishes.
Give a cream cake to a nearby player. Marked players glow gold only for you.
Start the final countdown to purify everyone. If it reaches zero, everyone except you dies and you win.
The <role> has begun Sanctification! <time> seconds remain!
The <role> has begun Sanctification! <time> seconds until the end!
Everyone has a cream cake! Use Sanctify!
Use Interactions To Spread Cream Cakes
After a kill, enter a short frenzy.\%nl\%Kill again quickly without cooldown.
You can perform multiple kills depending on options.
Cast curses that kill players after meetings.
Curse players with spells.\%nl\%Cursed targets are marked and die later.

The Witch is an Impostor Killing role that can cast spells on other players. Spellbound players are highlighted in the next meeting and die after the configured amount of meetings. If the Witch dies, gets exiled, or is guessed, all spellbound players survive.
Cast a spell on a player. They will be highlighted in the next meeting and die after the configured amount of meetings.
<player> has been cursed! They have <meetings> meeting(s) left. Vote out or kill the Witch to save them!
Multiple players have been cursed:\n<players>\nVote out or kill the Witch to save them!
Dash to move quickly.\%nl\%Place a Lantern to teleport back.

The <color=#D62020>Wraith</color> is an Impostor Power role focused on fast, unpredictable movement. Dash increases your movement speed by 75% for a short time. Lantern lets you place a hidden marker only you can see; reactivate it to teleport back and briefly swoop. If the Lantern expires before you return, it breaks and leaves permanent evidence visible to all players.
Temporarily increase your movement speed by 75%.
Place a Lantern only you can see. Reactivate it to teleport back and briefly turn invisible. If it expires, it breaks and leaves evidence visible to everyone.
Download system information and jam comms.
Download intel from devices.\%nl\%Use jam charges to disable equipment.

The Hacker is an Impostor Support role that can download information from nearby equipment to charge a portable device. Once you start downloading, you're locked into that equipment type until the next round. Jam disrupts information systems (Admin, Cams, etc.) and blocks all players from reporting bodies or calling emergency meetings. The Hacker is the only one who can still use their portable device during Jam or Communications sabotage.
Download data near a console (Admin, Cams, etc.) to charge your battery. You can use the device anywhere afterwards!
Use the downloaded system anywhere, consuming battery over time.

Turn off information systems for a short time (like sabotaging comms). During Jam, Emergency Meetings and Body Reports are disabled for all players, but the Hacker can still use their portable device during this time.
Your shield has been attacked! You have a moment for Backlash!
Steer a bomb-car to destroy the crew.
Deploy and drive an RC car.\%nl\%Detonate it near enemies.
The RC-XD is an Impostor Power role that can deploy and detonate an RC-XD car to kill players around the map. Use movement keys or joystick to steer it and detonate near enemies.
Deploy an RC car to steer it towards targets.
Detonate your RC car to kill nearby players.
Phase through walls and return to your start position.
Phase through walls and return later.\%nl\%Kill during Phase or you may die.

The Astral is an Impostor Concealing role that can enter an astral state. In this state, you can walk through walls. When the phase ends, you are teleported back to where you started. If configured, failing to kill someone during the phase will result in your death.
Die if no kill during Phase
Accelerate to gain speed and camouflage.\%nl\%Use the burst to ambush players.
Speedy is an Impostor Concealing role that can become camouflaged and fast to kill Crewmates.
Attach bombs to players and detonate them at the right moment.
Attach C4 to a player up close.\%nl\%Detonate after the arming delay.

The Detonator is a specialized Impostor who uses remote explosives to eliminate targets. Plant a bomb on any player and wait for the perfect moment to trigger it. Once the detonation becomes available, the target will hear a distinct beeping sound. The explosion kills the target and anyone nearby.
Attach a C4 charge to a player. You must wait for the short security delay to finish before you can detonate it.
Trigger your remote bomb to cause a massive explosion, killing the target and all nearby players instantly.
Complete all tasks to disable sabotages.
Finish all tasks to lock sabotages.\%nl\%The block lasts while you are alive.

The Forestaller is a Crewmate Support role that can prevent sabotages before they happen. After completing all tasks, sabotages are disabled while the Forestaller is alive. The Forestaller is revealed after finishing their last task.
Forestaller has completed all tasks. Sabotages are now disabled.
Blind the killers and expose them!
Blind killing roles with your power.\%nl\%Verify players to find who can kill.
Your ability allows you to blind all killing roles making them unable to kill, and making everybody look the same. During Evoke you can may verify if a person is in fact a killer or not.
Blind all killers. They won't be able to see or use any skills, including killing.
While Flash is activated u may verify players. If your screen flashes red this person is killing role.
Mediate to reveal dead players with bodies.\%nl\%You and the revealed ghosts may receive arrows to each other.
The Spirit Master is a Crewmate Investigative role that can mediate with dead players whose bodies still exist. The mediated ghost becomes visible to the Spirit Master and can guide them with arrows.
Communicate with the dead so they can lead you toward clues.
Inject players with beneficial effects\%nl\%to aid the Crew.
Inject players with helpful effects.\%nl\%Risky settings can cause side effects.

The Doctor is a Crewmate role that can inject players with various beneficial effects. Effects are randomly selected and can include speed boosts, vision increases, cleansing negative effects, or applying a one-time protective shield.
Inject a nearby player with a random beneficial effect. The effect will activate after a configurable delay.
You were protected by the Doctor's shield!
Your eyesight has returned to normal.
Prime and place decoys.\%nl\%Triggered decoys vanish and alert you.

The Mirage is a Crewmate Support role that can place a decoy with the appearance of a chosen target (yourself or a random player). If any player interacts with the decoy, it disappears instantly and both the Mirage and the toucher receive a notification. Note: Mirage cannot be guessed if the decoy has the appearance of yourself.
Prime a clone, and click again to place it. If anyone touches it, you will be notified.
Inject targets with random effects.\%nl\%Use them to disrupt or set up kills.

The Injector is an Impostor Support role that can inject players with various negative effects. Effects are randomly selected and can include inverted controls, reduced vision, slowness, or confusion.
Inject a nearby player with a random negative effect. The effect will activate after a configurable delay.
Your vision has returned to normal.
The speed boost has worn off.
Your vision has returned to normal.
Manipulate body reports to your advantage.
Deceive reports bodies from afar.\%nl\%Conceal reduces nearby report ranges.

The Charlatan is an Impostor Support role that manipulates body reports. Deceive allows you to report bodies you've killed from any distance for a limited time after killing. Conceal reduces the report range of nearby bodies, but requires you to stay near the body for the duration.
Report the body you just killed from anywhere on the map.
Make it so nobody can report this body. You must stand near it to hide it.
Eat dead bodies to win alone.
Track and eat dead bodies.\%nl\%Eat enough to win alone.

The Vulture is a Neutral Evil role whose goal is to eat a set amount of dead bodies. Optionally, the Vulture can use Scavenge to get arrows pointing to corpses. If the Vulture\'s win condition can no longer be met, they become the configured role.
Eat a nearby dead body. This counts toward your win condition.
Get arrows pointing to all corpses for a duration. If a corpse is on a different floor on Submerged, the arrow will point to the elevator.

When you are voted out, everyone who voted for you receives a negative effect.

Hunt your assigned targets to victory. Do not kill the wrong target!
Hunt assigned targets one by one.\%nl\%Eliminate them all to win.

The Bounty Hunter is a Neutral Evil role whose mission is to eliminate a specific number of targets. Only killing your assigned target brings you closer to victory.\%nl\%\%nl\%Although you are free to kill ANY player on the map, attempting to kill anyone other than your current target using your Hunt button will result in your instant execution by the Guild (Suicide). Strategy and precision are key.
Kill a player. If it's your assigned target, you get closer to victory. If it's NOT your target, you will die immediately (Suicide).

Poison enemies or trap them with vines.
Poison close targets to kill after delay.\%nl\%Use Vine to trap and crush a victim.
An Impostor who can poison players on contact or use vines to trap a target and kill them after a stasis delay.

Gives a shield to a player. The shield reacts to all kill attempts (including Crewmate Killing roles like Sheriff). If someone tries to kill the protected player, the Bodyguard can teleport to them and eliminate the attacker. You can only kill the attacker, and if you do, you die along with them (Sacrifice is absolute and ignores all shields).
Give someone a shield. If someone attacks them, you will be able to teleport to them.

Dark Blue Name On Who Attacked

The Drunk has their movement controls permanently inverted for {meetings} meetings. They cannot be guessed.
Soar above and see the bigger picture.
Zoom out to watch more of the map.\%nl\%Use the view to track movement.
You can zoom out the screen for a few seconds. You can't use this at light sabotage.
Zoom out the camera to see a wider area for a limited duration. Cannot be used during lights sabotage.
Use your intuition to discover who is working together.
Use Gaze and Intuit on two players.\%nl\%Learn whether they are aligned.
You are a very wise person, that can tell if two people win or lose together.
Select the first player to compare.
Select the second player to compare. If a Gaze target is already set, the comparison will trigger.
A Crewmate modifier that grants limited access to vents. You have a set number of vent uses with a cooldown between each use and a maximum duration per vent stay.
Kill players to steal their appearance.\%nl\%Disguises last until a meeting.
If u kill a player u will steal his identity for the rest of the round.
Write their name... and they die.
Find the Death Note near a vent.\%nl\%Write a player's name to curse them with a delayed death.
The Death Note has been used.
The Death Note is spawning on random vent. If u find it, u can write a player's name to curse them. They will die of a Heart Attack after the timer expires.
Find the Death Note near a random vent and write the name of a living player. After the configured timer expires, that player dies of a Heart Attack. The Death Note is consumed immediately after use.
Wrap a target in a lethal shadow trap.
Shroud a player with a lethal mark.\%nl\%Their next visitor dies, or they die at the next meeting.

The Shroud is a Neutral Killing role that turns players into lethal bait. Shroud one target each round. The first player who interacts with that target dies in their place. If nobody triggers the trap before a meeting starts, the shrouded target is claimed instead.
Place a lethal shroud on a player. Their next visitor dies instead of them; if nobody visits before the meeting, the marked player dies.
Stake Vampires to remove them.\%nl\%When none remain, you become a new role.

The Vampire Hunter spawns only when Vampires are in the game. After the first meeting, a random Crewmate is converted into the Vampire Hunter. They can stake players if the player is a Vampire, they die. If not, the stake is used. When all Vampires are eliminated, the Vampire Hunter converts into another Crewmate role.
Stake a nearby player. If they are a Vampire, they die. If not, you waste a stake use.
Self Kill On All Stakes Failed
Sacrifice yourself in a massive explosion and take your enemies down with you!
Sacrifice yourself in an explosion.\%nl\%All nearby players are killed.

The Kamikaze is an Impostor role that can detonate themselves, killing all players within the blast radius. The Kamikaze dies in the process. Use the regular kill button normally, and activate the suicide button when the moment is right to take out as many enemies as possible.
Blow yourself up! You will kill everyone around you, but you will also die.
You can see color votes of others during meetings.
You can see the color votes of all\%nl\%players during meetings.
See the real color votes of all players during meetings.

When a kill is blocked by a shield, the killer sees a colored flash indicating which role provided the protection: • Dark Green - Medic • Purple - Warden • Cyan/Teal - Cleric • Silver Blue - Mirrorcaster • Light Blue - Fairy • Mauve - Mercenary • Dark Blue - Bodyguard • Magenta - Oracle (meeting protection)

Draft Mode replaces normal role assignment with a strategic pick phase before the game starts. • Players are assigned a side (Crewmate, Impostor, or Neutral) and then choose their specific role in a randomized turn order. • Each player is offered 3 unique roles. Spectators are excluded from the process and do not take up pick slots. • If you do not pick in time, a role will be automatically assigned to you based on your assigned side. • By default, all players draft from the complete pool of enabled roles for their side (Crewmate, Impostor, or Neutral). Restrictive categories have been removed for a more flexible experience.

Apocalypse roles are horsemen-style neutral threats: Plaguebearer, Pestilence, Baker, Famine, Soul Collector, Death, Berserker, and War. If Apocalypse Wins Together is enabled, they share victory, cannot guess each other, and reveal each other's roles. Apocalypse meeting chat is controlled in General settings.

Before the draft begins, players are assigned a faction that determines their available role pool. • Impostors draft from the full pool of available Impostor roles. • Crewmates choose from the full pool of available Crewmate roles. If Other Neutrals (Benign, Evil, or Outlier) are enabled in the lobby, these roles will be mixed into the Crewmate's choice pool until global targets are met. • Neutral Killing draft from available killing factions. • Global Targets - Lobby settings control the Min/Max number of players assigned to Neutral Killing and Other Neutral (Benign/Evil/Outlier) factions. • 60/40 Logic - The system uses a weighted probability to favor minimum targets while allowing for occasional maximums to keep games unpredictable. Drafting follows individual role chances if "Use Role Chances" is enabled, using a Weighted Shuffle. If Neutrals Per Choice is configured, the number of Neutral roles shown per turn can be strictly limited (this setting applies to Crewmates only).
This section contains advanced options for existing roles and modifiers, enhancing their abilities and gameplay mechanics.

Vampires have advanced sabotage options: • Only Lights - The Vampire can only sabotage the Electrical system via the TAB map. • Shared Cooldown - Vampires share the same global sabotage timer with Impostors. • Only OG - Sabotage can be restricted to the original Vampire only (bitten vampires cannot sabotage).
Configure extension options for existing roles and modifiers here!

TOUMCE introduces several global settings that change the game flow: • System of Thirds - A balanced pick order that distributes Impostors and Neutrals evenly across the beginning, middle, and end of the draft phase. • Use Role Chances - If enabled, the probability of roles appearing in the Draft will be based on their individual 'Chance' settings in the lobby. • Neutrals Per Choice - Controls how many Neutral roles are mixed into each Crewmate's selection pool. • Global Neutral Limits - Hard limits for the total number of Neutral roles (NK and others) allowed in a single round. • Reduce Killing Streak - Decreases the chance of players becoming a killing role again if they were one in the previous round. • Impostor / Neutral Killing - Specific reduction chances for each major killing faction.
Gather recruits and survive to kill.
Recruit two players from other factions.\%nl\%When recruits die, your kill unlocks.

The Infiltrator plays the long game through proxy survival. You start with two Lifelinked Recruits. Protect your identity while they work for you. \%nl\%While they live, they grant you a Shield. You only gain the ability to Assassinate once all recruits have perished. \%nl\% \%nl\%"Infiltration is a slow poison."
Eliminate a nearby player. This ability is only available after all Recruits have died.

You start with two recruits who work for you. They are Lifelinked and tagged with (REC). You can see their roles and read their private chat. While they live, they grant you a shield. Once they die, you gain the ability to kill. \%nl\% \%nl\%"Loyalty is earned, but betrayal is strategic."
Your recruits are dead! Kill ability unlocks in 10s.
Protects the Infiltrator from any killing attempt as long as at least one Recruit is alive.
You have been recruited by the Infiltrator. You must betray your team.
<color=#E0E0E0>You have been recruited by the Infiltrator, betray your team!</color>
You were recruited by the Infiltrator.\%nl\%Protect them and win with their team.
Protect the Infiltrator and help them eliminate other factions. You are lifelinked to another Recruit.
View information about your fellow Recruits and your mission status.
You have been recruited by the Infiltrator. Protect them and work with other recruits.
You have been recruited by the Infiltrator! You are now a Recruit. Your goal has changed - you only win with the Infiltrator.
Draw magical cards to change the tide of the game.
Draw Tarot cards from your deck.\%nl\%Each card triggers a different effect.
The Arcanist is a Neutral Outlier role that draws random Tarot cards to affect players and change the tide of the game.
Draw a magical Tarot card from your deck. Each card triggers a different mystical effect.
{0}: Role already exists! Card removed from deck.
Someone has made a deal with the Devil and become a Lawyer!
Create portals to travel quickly across the map.
Place two linked portals.\%nl\%Players entering one exit the other.
The Portalmaker is a Crewmate role that can link two points on the map with portals accessible to all crewmates.
Create protective garden zones to shield your allies.
Plant gardens that block attacks.\%nl\%You are alerted when attacks happen inside.

The Gardener is a Crewmate Protective role that can place protective garden zones. Anyone inside a garden is completely shielded from kills. If a kill is attempted, it is blocked, and you are immediately notified.
Plants a protective garden zone. Crewmates within the garden are shielded from attacks, and any attacks attempted or made inside the garden are immediately notified to the Gardener.
Places one of two portals connecting zones.
Transports the player to the other portal in the pair.
Player {0} was attacked in your garden!
Player {0} was eliminated in your garden!
Use Emergency Cooldown In First Round
Aim carefully and eliminate targets from afar.
Enter Aiming to shoot from range.\%nl\%Click visible targets while standing still.
The Sniper is an Impostor Killing role that can remotely shoot targets.\%nl\%When you use your ability, you enter aiming mode and cannot move. Click on a target on your screen to eliminate them.
Enter aiming mode, stand in place, and click on a target on your screen to shoot them remotely.
Aim carefully and eliminate targets from afar.
Enter Aiming to shoot from range.\%nl\%Click visible targets while standing still.
The Sniper is an Impostor Killing role that can remotely shoot targets.\%nl\%When you use your ability, you enter aiming mode and cannot move. Click on a target on your screen to eliminate them.
Enter aiming mode, stand in place, and click on a target on your screen to shoot them remotely.
Kill players to cycle through Impostor roles. \%b\%Cannot become an Impostor Power role.\%/b\%
The Gun Game is an Impostor Power role that changes role after enough kills. Each new role gives you different abilities and cooldowns. \%b\%Cannot become an Impostor Power role.\%/b\%
Gun Game Must Be Guessed As
Place clones of living players. Win when enough clones are killed.
The Joker is a Neutral Evil role that places clones of living players. When a clone is killed, it counts toward your win. Win after enough clones are killed.
Place a clone of a living player.
Objective complete! You are now Victorious

The Baker is a Neutral Killing role that gives bread to living players. Breaded players are marked for you and trigger alerts when they die. Give enough bread to become \%color=#023020FF\%Famine\%/color\%.
Give bread to a nearby living player.
A terrible famine has consumed the Crew.\%nl\%\%color=#023020FF\%Famine\%/color\%, Horseman of the Apocalypse, has emerged!
All your breaded targets died! You can now starve anyone!
Kill to shorten your cooldown and become War.
Kill players to reduce your cooldown.\%nl\%Collect enough kills to become <color=#5E3929>War</color>.

The Berserker is a Neutral Apocalypse role. Each kill lowers your kill cooldown, helping you snowball into War.\%nl\%Once transformed, you lose cooldown reduction and become an invincible horseman who can chain kills during a short spree window.\%nl\%If Apocalypse Wins Together is enabled, Apocalypse roles are treated as allies.
Kill players to reduce your cooldown and evolve into War.
After enough kills, evolve into War and gain the final horseman's power.
War has consumed the battlefield.\%nl\%\%color=#5E3929FF\%War\%/color\%, Horseman of the Apocalypse, has emerged!
Transformed Berserker.\%nl\%Chain kills during short sprees.\%nl\%War is invincible.

The <color=#5E3929>War</color> is the transformed <color=#880814>Berserker</color>.\%nl\%War is invincible, cannot be guessed, and can only die by being voted out.\%nl\%After a successful kill, War enters a short Killing Spree where the next kill has no cooldown.
War Evolved: the battlefield is yours.
Transformed Baker.\%nl\%Starved players die next meeting.\%nl\%Once breaded targets die, starve anyone.\%nl\%Famine is invincible.

The Famine is the transformed Baker. Famine is invincible, cannot be guessed, and can only die by being voted out.\%nl\%Initially, Famine can only starve players who received bread from Baker. After all breaded players are dead, Famine can starve any player. Starved players die at the next meeting.
Famine Evolved: the hunger spreads to all.
Mark a breaded player to die next meeting.
Recruit during meetings to restore your team. \%nl\%\%b\%Cannot become an Impostor Power or Killing role.\%/b\%

The Loner is an Impostor Power role that starts with one fewer teammate. Recruit a non-Impostor during a meeting to restore your team. After recruiting, kill enough players to gain a new Impostor role. \%b\%Cannot become an Impostor Power or Killing role.\%/b\%
You were recruited by the Loner!
Your Loner cover broke! You are now <role>!
Kills After Recruit Needed To Gain New Role
Avoid Impostor Roles Used This Game
Dig underground and emerge to link two vents.
The Tunneler is an Impostor Concealing role that creates hidden tunnels. Dig to enter a vent after a short delay and travel underground. Emerge to create a linked vent pair.
Dig underground and emerge through a linked vent.
Mode: Random role after enough kills
The Foreteller is a Neutral Evil role that wins by guessing \%guessCount\% players' roles.
The Foreteller is a Neutral Evil role that wins by guessing \%guessCount\% players' roles. They may observe players to get a hint of what their roles are the following meeting.
Foreteller Can Guess Crew Investigative Roles
Foreteller Guesses All Roles At Once
The Hex Master is an Impostor Power role that can hex a player, priming them for detonation. Once all non-Impostors are hexed, they may set off a Hex Bomb after a set amount of time to win.
The \%role\% is unleashing a Hex Bomb! Find them before the timer ends! \%time\% seconds remain after this meeting.
The \%role\% is unleashing a Hex Bomb in \%time\% seconds!
Reap souls and leave lifeless shadows behind.
Reap players without leaving reportable bodies.
The Grim Reaper is a Neutral Killing role that reaps players directly. Reaped players leave behind a soul-less decoy instead of a normal reportable body.
You have reaped \%player\%, leaving their lifeless shadow standing.
Reap a nearby player and leave behind a lifeless shadow instead of a reportable body.

Taunt a player for a short time.\%nl\%Win if that killer is voted out at the next meeting.

The Innocent is a Neutral Evil role. Use Taunt on a living player. During the configured time window, if the closest player near the taunted player is a Crewmate, the taunted player kills and reports them as if they hit Bait. If that killer is voted out at the next meeting, the Innocent wins. If limited taunts run out without a win, the Innocent transforms into the configured role.

The Voodoo Master is an Impostor Support role that cycles between three curses and casts the selected curse on a living player. Blindness covers the target's vision, mute silences them during meetings, and confuse makes living players appear scrambled to them.
Choose a living player and apply the currently selected Voodoo curse.
Curse a player with blindness. After the configured delay, their vision is fully covered for the configured duration.

Curse a player with mute. The curse triggers at the next meeting and prevents only that player from chatting for the configured number of meetings. Only the muted player knows they are muted; other players are not told and do not see a meeting overlay like Blackmailer.
Curse a player with confuse. After the configured delay, living players appear scrambled to the target like Herbalist Confuse, making players harder to identify.
Switch between blindness, mute, and confuse.

Win with the Crewmates from inside the Impostor chat.\%nl\%You can speak there, but their names stay hidden.

The Agent is a Crewmate Investigative role that appears friendly to the Impostors. They can read and send Impostor chat messages, but all Impostor names are hidden from them. Impostors cannot shoot or guess the Agent, and the Agent wins with the Crewmates.
